This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.description:

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

1	# u4-l1 MLA 前半：q_a/kv_a/q_b 投影与 norm
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 画出 MLA 前半（front half）的两条投影形状链：查询链 `hidden → q_a(2048) → q_b → 64 头 × 256`，键值链 `hidden → kv_a(512+64)`，并说出每个数字对应的 config 常量。
8	2. 理解 latent KV 表示：为什么每个 token 每层只需缓存 512 维压缩向量 + 64 维 rope 分量，而不是逐头的 K/V。
9	3. 分清 `fp8_linear_into` / `fp8_linear_pair_into` / `fp8_linear_partials_into` / `fp8_linear_large_m_into` 四个投影变体的行数适用域，以及 `Glm52MlaFront` 为它们准备的持久缓冲。
10	4. 读懂 `Glm52MlaLayerWeights::from_device` 的装载期形状校验，以及 `qa_kva` 打包权重的构建条件、显存记账（约 1.2 GiB）与 #812 宽桶复用。
11	
12	## 2. 前置知识
13	
14	本讲承接 u3-l1（FP8 块量化原语）与 u2-l1（模型几何常量），只增量引入 MLA 本身的概念。
15	
16	- **KV cache 是推理显存的头号开销**。标准多头注意力里，每个 token 每层要缓存 heads × head_dim 份 K 和 V。以 GLM5.2 为例，64 头 × 256 维如果逐头缓存，一个 token 一层就是两份 [64, 256] 形状的 bf16 张量。
17	- **MLA（Multi-head Latent Attention，多头潜在注意力）**的解法是把 KV 低秩压缩：键值先投到一个很小的 latent 向量（GLM5.2 是 512 维），缓存里只存这个 latent；注意力计算时再用上采矩阵把 latent 展开成每个头自己的 K/V。
18	- **低秩直觉**：kv_b 矩阵 \( W_{KV} \) 可以近似分解为「下投影 \( W_{down} \)（hidden → 512）」和「上投影 \( W_{UK}/W_{UV} \)（512 → 每头 K/V）」两步。缓存里只保留中间量 \( c_{kv} = W_{down} \cdot h \)，上投影可以合并进注意力里的 Q 侧（这就是 u4-l3 要讲的 absorb）。
19	- **fp8 投影族**（u3-l1 已建立）：小 batch（不超过 8 行）走 weight-only GEMV，权重 fp8、激活保持 bf16；大 batch 走「激活量化 + SM100 groupwise GEMM」。分界常量是 FP8_GEMV_MAX_ROWS = 8（[src/fp8.rs:35](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L35)）。
20	- **RMSNorm**：比 LayerNorm 少一次均值中心化，只除以均方根再乘缩放系数：
21	
22	\[ \mathrm{RMSNorm}(x) = \frac{x}{\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i} x_i^2 + \epsilon}} \odot \gamma \]
23	
24	GLM5.2 全模型的 \( \epsilon = 10^{-5} \)，见 GLM52_RMS_NORM_EPS（[src/config.rs:47-50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L47-L50)）。
25	- **Rows<C>**（u3-l3 已建立）：用 const 泛型把缓冲宽度变成类型事实的行缓冲包装，本讲里 q_resid: Rows(2048) 与 hidden: Rows(6144) 都是它。
26	- **指针稳定性**（为 u6-l3 CUDA Graph 铺垫）：整步前向会被捕获成 CUDA Graph 回放，所有中间缓冲的指针必须步与步之间不变——所以 front 的中间量放在启动期一次性分配的持久 scratch 里，每步原地覆写。

43	### 4.1 投影链与形状数学
44	
45	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
46	
47	MLA 前半场做两件事：
48	
49	1. **查询链**：当前步的 hidden 状态先压到 2048 维的低秩空间（q_a），做一次 RMSNorm（q_a_layernorm），再升维展开成 64 个注意力头的查询向量（q_b）。查询不进缓存，每步现算。
50	2. **键值链**：hidden 压到 576 维（kv_a）= 512 维 latent + 64 维 rope 分量。这个 576 维向量就是每个 token 写进 KV cache 的全部内容——它会在 cache-pack 阶段按层切片落盘（u4-l2 展开）。
51	
52	「前半场/后半场」切分的意义：前半场只依赖 hidden 本身，**在 DSA 索引器选出稀疏 top-k 之前就能全部算完**；后半场才需要知道选了哪些 token。这个切分让索引器可以和 q_b/kv_a 投影在两条 stream 上并行（见 4.3.2 的 front_q/front_rest 拆分）。
53

55	
56	一步之内的形状链（T 为本步行数，全宽 heads = 64）：

60	  hidden [T, 6144]
61	    --q_a_proj  (fp8 [2048, 6144])-->  q_a     [T, 2048]
62	    --q_a_layernorm (RMSNorm, gamma 长度 2048)-->  q_resid [T, 2048]
63	    --q_b_proj  (fp8 [16384, 2048])-->  q_full  [T, 64, 256]   ← 每头 192 nope + 64 rope

68	    --ckv split-->  kv_c_raw [T, 512]  +  k_pe [T, 64]
69	    --kv_a_layernorm (RMSNorm, gamma 长度 512)-->  kv_c [T, 512]
70	  （k_pe 保持原样，rope 旋转发生在 attend 半场）

105	### 4.2 head 维度分解与 latent KV 表示
106	
107	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
108	
109	每个查询头的 256 维被拆成两部分：
110	
111	- **nope 192 维**（GLM52_QK_NOPE_HEAD_DIM）：不做位置编码的「内容」部分，可以吸收进 latent 空间计算；
112	- **rope 64 维**（GLM52_QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM）：做 RoPE 旋转的部分。RoPE 的逐位置旋转无法塞进低秩 latent——旋转作用在原始 64 维坐标上，Q/K 必须在旋转后的空间里做内积，所以 rope 分量单独投影、单独缓存（k_pe）。
113	
114	KV 侧同理：latent 512 维（kv_c，norm 之后）+ rope 64 维（k_pe）。**缓存里每 token 每层的 MLA 内容就是 512 + 64 = 576 个 bf16**，与头数无关——这就是 MLA 对 KV cache 的压缩本质。对比逐头 MHA：64 头 × 256 维 × 2（K 和 V）= 32768 个数，压缩比约 28 倍。
115	
116	注意力打分的 softmax scale 也由这个分解决定：\( 1/\sqrt{256} = 0.0625 \)，即 GLM52_SM_SCALE（[src/config.rs:37-39](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L37-L39)），注释说明 rope_type 为 default 意味着没有 YaRN mscale 修正。
117	
118	kv_b 的 448 = 192 + 256 行拆成两个吸收因子：
119	
120	\[ W_{UK} = \text{kv\_b}[:, :192, :] \in \mathbb{R}^{64 \times 192 \times 512}, \quad W_{UV} = \text{kv\_b}[:, 192:, :] \in \mathbb{R}^{64 \times 256 \times 512} \]
121	
122	u4-l3 会讲它们如何被「吸收」进 query 侧；本讲只需记住：**kv_b 不以 fp8 形式驻留，装载时在 host 上反量化成 bf16 的 W_UK/W_UV 上传**。
123	
124	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
125	
126	kv 侧的数据流（decode 路径，fold_kv_pack = false）：
127	
128	~~~text
129	hidden [T, 6144]
130	  --kv_a (fp8 GEMV/GEMM)-->  ckv [T, 576]        ← compressed_kv(512) 与 k_pe(64) 拼接存放
131	  --glm52_mla_ckv_split_launch-->  kv_c_raw [T, 512]  +  k_pe [T, 64]   ← 设备端拆包
132	  --rms_norm_rows_into(kv_a_ln, KV_LORA)-->  kv_c [T, 512]
133	~~~
134	
135	要点：
136	
137	- ckv 是「拼接布局」，因为 kv_a 是**一次** GEMM 算出 576 维；拆包（split）与 norm 是两个独立 kernel；
138	- norm 只作用于 512 维的 kv_c_raw，64 维 rope 分量**不做 norm**；
139	- FlashInfer 后端走 fold_kv_pack = true 时这条链在 front 里提前结束：split 与 norm 被融合进 attend 侧的 glm52_mla_front_pack_fp8_launch，ckv 保持 raw（[src/mla_front.rs:544-549](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L544-L549) 与 [src/mla_decode.rs:337](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_decode.rs#L337)）。同一条数学链，两种 kernel 编排——这是「算什么」与「怎么算」分离的典型例子。

169	### 4.3 front scratch 持久缓冲与 fp8 投影调度
170	
171	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
172	
173	Glm52MlaFront 是前半场的全部中间量容器，设计上有三个关键决定：
174	
175	1. **持久 + 原地覆写**：缓冲在启动期按 bucket 尺寸一次性分配，每步由 front_q/front_rest 原地写入。这是整步 CUDA Graph（u6-l3）的前提——graph 回放要求指针不变，原地覆写让「重放」等价于「重算」。
176	2. **78 层共享一个实例**：layer N 的 front 值在 layer N 的 attend 消费后即死，所以不需要 78 份 scratch（[src/mla_front.rs:300-307](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L300-L307) 的结构体注释）。
177	3. **行数烤进 scratch**：tokens 在构造时固定，所有 front kernel 从 front.tokens()（即 q_resid.tokens()）取行数，单一事实来源（[src/mla_front.rs:376-379](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L376-L379)）。
178	
179	decode 与 prefill 两形态：decode 版多带 GEMV partial 缓冲、打包输出 sink 和（行数超过 8 时）wide GEMM scratch；prefill 版（new_prefill）把这些缩成 1 个元素的占位（[src/mla_front.rs:329-336](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L329-L336) 与 [L357-365](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L357-L365)），因为 prefill 永远走大 batch GEMM 路径。
180	
181	**fp8 投影变体的行数适用域**（承接 u3-l1）：
182	
183	| 变体 | 位置 | 适用域 | front 里的对应缓冲 |
184	|------|------|--------|--------------------|
185	| fp8_linear_into | [src/fp8.rs:392](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L392) | 小 m 的 weight-only GEMV（t 不超过 8） | gemv_partial |
186	| fp8_linear_pair_into | [src/fp8.rs:437](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L437) | t = 1，两个共享输入的投影并一次 grid | 复用输出缓冲 |
187	| fp8_linear_partials_into | [src/fp8.rs:415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L415) | mma 表有路由的打包权重（batched mma） | gemv_partial + qa_kva_out |
188	| fp8_linear_large_m_into | [src/fp8.rs:66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L66) | 大 m：激活量化 + groupwise GEMM（t 超过 8 或 prefill） | wide: Glm52Fp8GemmScratch |
189	
190	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
191	
192	decode 前半场被拆成两个入口（layer.rs 在中间插入 DSA 索引器）：
193	
194	~~~text
195	layer 一步（简化）:
196	  glm52_mla_front_q_into(...)        # q 相：q_a 投影 + q_a_layernorm → q_resid
197	  —— 把 q_resid 交给 DSA 索引器（aux stream 可并行）——
198	  glm52_mla_front_rest_into(...)     # rest 相：q_b + kv_a + split + kv_a norm
199	~~~
200	
201	front_q 内部按行数 t 分派 q_a（kv_a 同吃 hidden，被一并处理）：
202	
203	~~~text
204	if t == 1:
205	    fp8_linear_pair_into(q_a, kv_a)          # 一次拼接 grid 算两个投影，少一个 graph 节点
206	elif qa_kva_fused(t):                        # mma 表对该行数与打包形状 [2624, 6144] 有路由
207	    fp8_linear_partials_into(qa_kva 打包权重)  # 部分和进 gemv_partial
208	    glm52_gemv_split_reduce_launch(...)       # 把部分和拆解回 q_a [T,2048] 与 ckv [T,576]
209	elif wide 存在 (t > 8):
210	    有打包权重: fp8_linear_large_m_into(qa_kva)   # 一次 GEMM + 一次激活量化
211	               + extract_hidden_rows_raw_into × 2  # 从 [T,2624] 切出 q_a 与 ckv
212	    无打包权重: fp8_linear_large_m_into(q_a)
213	else:
214	    fp8_linear_into(q_a)                      # 普通 weight-only GEMV（2..8 行且无路由）
215	最后统一: rms_norm_rows_into(q_a → q_resid)
216	~~~
217	
218	front_rest 的 kv_a 有三个「跳过」条件（已经有人算过）：t == 1（pair 算过）、qa_kva_fused（fused mma 算过）、qa_kva_packed_wide（wide 打包 GEMM 算过），三者以或关系合并在一行判断里（[src/mla_front.rs:583](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L583)）。

296	- MLA 前半场 = 两条投影链：查询链 hidden [T,6144] → q_a [T,2048] → RMSNorm → q_resid → q_b → q_full [T,heads,256]，键值链 hidden → kv_a → ckv [T,576] → split → kv_c [T,512] + k_pe [T,64]；全部维度由 [src/config.rs:20-32](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L20-L32) 的编译期常量推导。

# u4-l1 MLA 前半：q_a/kv_a/q_b 投影与 norm

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲你应该能够：

1. 画出 MLA 前半（front half）的两条投影形状链：查询链 `hidden → q_a(2048) → q_b → 64 头 × 256`，键值链 `hidden → kv_a(512+64)`，并说出每个数字对应的 config 常量。
2. 理解 latent KV 表示：为什么每个 token 每层只需缓存 512 维压缩向量 + 64 维 rope 分量，而不是逐头的 K/V。
3. 分清 `fp8_linear_into` / `fp8_linear_pair_into` / `fp8_linear_partials_into` / `fp8_linear_large_m_into` 四个投影变体的行数适用域，以及 `Glm52MlaFront` 为它们准备的持久缓冲。
4. 读懂 `Glm52MlaLayerWeights::from_device` 的装载期形状校验，以及 `qa_kva` 打包权重的构建条件、显存记账（约 1.2 GiB）与 #812 宽桶复用。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲承接 u3-l1（FP8 块量化原语）与 u2-l1（模型几何常量），只增量引入 MLA 本身的概念。

- **KV cache 是推理显存的头号开销**。标准多头注意力里，每个 token 每层要缓存 heads × head_dim 份 K 和 V。以 GLM5.2 为例，64 头 × 256 维如果逐头缓存，一个 token 一层就是两份 [64, 256] 形状的 bf16 张量。
- **MLA（Multi-head Latent Attention，多头潜在注意力）**的解法是把 KV 低秩压缩：键值先投到一个很小的 latent 向量（GLM5.2 是 512 维），缓存里只存这个 latent；注意力计算时再用上采矩阵把 latent 展开成每个头自己的 K/V。
- **低秩直觉**：kv_b 矩阵 \( W_{KV} \) 可以近似分解为「下投影 \( W_{down} \)（hidden → 512）」和「上投影 \( W_{UK}/W_{UV} \)（512 → 每头 K/V）」两步。缓存里只保留中间量 \( c_{kv} = W_{down} \cdot h \)，上投影可以合并进注意力里的 Q 侧（这就是 u4-l3 要讲的 absorb）。
- **fp8 投影族**（u3-l1 已建立）：小 batch（不超过 8 行）走 weight-only GEMV，权重 fp8、激活保持 bf16；大 batch 走「激活量化 + SM100 groupwise GEMM」。分界常量是 FP8_GEMV_MAX_ROWS = 8（[src/fp8.rs:35](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L35)）。
- **RMSNorm**：比 LayerNorm 少一次均值中心化，只除以均方根再乘缩放系数：

\[ \mathrm{RMSNorm}(x) = \frac{x}{\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i} x_i^2 + \epsilon}} \odot \gamma \]

GLM5.2 全模型的 \( \epsilon = 10^{-5} \)，见 GLM52_RMS_NORM_EPS（[src/config.rs:47-50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L47-L50)）。
- **Rows<C>**（u3-l3 已建立）：用 const 泛型把缓冲宽度变成类型事实的行缓冲包装，本讲里 q_resid: Rows(2048) 与 hidden: Rows(6144) 都是它。
- **指针稳定性**（为 u6-l3 CUDA Graph 铺垫）：整步前向会被捕获成 CUDA Graph 回放，所有中间缓冲的指针必须步与步之间不变——所以 front 的中间量放在启动期一次性分配的持久 scratch 里，每步原地覆写。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 |
|------|------|
| [src/mla_front.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L1-L5) | 本讲主角（624 行）：每层注意力权重 Glm52MlaLayerWeights、持久 scratch Glm52MlaFront、三个执行入口（prefill / decode q 相 / decode rest 相） |
| [src/config.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L9-L50) | 几何常量的唯一来源（u2-l1 已建立），MLA 相关常量集中在 L20-L50 |
| [src/fp8.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L35) | 投影 kernel 调度层（u3-l1 已建立），本讲只引用四个入口函数 |
| [src/layer.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/layer.rs#L212-L257) | 消费方：decoder 层在 L212 调 front_q，L230 把 q_resid 交给 DSA 索引器，L257 调 front_rest |
| [src/mla_decode.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_decode.rs#L404-L507) | 消费方（u4-l3 主角）：attend 半场读 q_full / kv_c / k_pe / ckv |
| [src/oracle/mla.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/oracle/mod.rs#L12) | MLA 精度门（u10-l1 展开），本讲实践任务会用到它的运行命令 |

模块头的定位说明：[src/mla_front.rs:1-5](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L1-L5) 写明本文件是「前半场」——从 hidden（形状 T 行 × 6144 列）到持久 front scratch 的 q_a/kv_a/q_b 投影与 norm，加上本层的驻留权重；「后半场」（absorb、FlashMLA 稀疏解码、o_proj）在 mla_decode 里消费 front 的缓冲。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 投影链与形状数学

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

MLA 前半场做两件事：

1. **查询链**：当前步的 hidden 状态先压到 2048 维的低秩空间（q_a），做一次 RMSNorm（q_a_layernorm），再升维展开成 64 个注意力头的查询向量（q_b）。查询不进缓存，每步现算。
2. **键值链**：hidden 压到 576 维（kv_a）= 512 维 latent + 64 维 rope 分量。这个 576 维向量就是每个 token 写进 KV cache 的全部内容——它会在 cache-pack 阶段按层切片落盘（u4-l2 展开）。

「前半场/后半场」切分的意义：前半场只依赖 hidden 本身，**在 DSA 索引器选出稀疏 top-k 之前就能全部算完**；后半场才需要知道选了哪些 token。这个切分让索引器可以和 q_b/kv_a 投影在两条 stream 上并行（见 4.3.2 的 front_q/front_rest 拆分）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一步之内的形状链（T 为本步行数，全宽 heads = 64）：

~~~text
查询链（不进缓存，每步重算）:
  hidden [T, 6144]
    --q_a_proj  (fp8 [2048, 6144])-->  q_a     [T, 2048]
    --q_a_layernorm (RMSNorm, gamma 长度 2048)-->  q_resid [T, 2048]
    --q_b_proj  (fp8 [16384, 2048])-->  q_full  [T, 64, 256]   ← 每头 192 nope + 64 rope

键值链（写入 KV cache 的全部内容）:
  hidden [T, 6144]
    --kv_a_proj_with_mqa (fp8 [576, 6144])-->  ckv [T, 576]
    --ckv split-->  kv_c_raw [T, 512]  +  k_pe [T, 64]
    --kv_a_layernorm (RMSNorm, gamma 长度 512)-->  kv_c [T, 512]
  （k_pe 保持原样，rope 旋转发生在 attend 半场）
~~~

派生量全部来自 config 常量：GLM52_Q_B_OUT = 64 × 256 = 16384、GLM52_KV_A_OUT = 512 + 64 = 576、GLM52_KV_B_OUT = 64 × 448 = 28672（[src/config.rs:29-32](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L29-L32)）。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**几何常量（config 唯一来源）**：[src/config.rs:20-32](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L20-L32) 定义了本讲用到的全部 MLA 维度：GLM52_HEADS = 64、GLM52_Q_LORA_RANK = 2048、GLM52_KV_LORA_RANK = 512、GLM52_QK_NOPE_HEAD_DIM = 192、GLM52_QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM = 64、GLM52_QK_HEAD_DIM = 192 + 64、GLM52_V_HEAD_DIM = 256，以及派生输出宽度 GLM52_Q_B_OUT / GLM52_KV_A_OUT / GLM52_KV_B_OUT / GLM52_O_PROJ_IN。

**模块内别名**：[src/mla_front.rs:43-54](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L43-L54) 把这些常量起成短名（Q_LORA、KV_LORA、Q_HEAD、KV_A_OUT、KV_B_ROWS_PER_HEAD = QK_NOPE + V_HEAD 即 448），注释说明「形状数学密集，数值只放在一处」。这是本 crate 的普遍风格：**形状数字永远从 config 编译期常量推导，不出现魔法数**。

**装载期形状自检**：[src/mla_front.rs:100-114](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L100-L114)（from_host，测试路径）逐个把 checkpoint 张量钉死到架构形状：q_a [2048, 6144]、q_b [heads×256, 2048]、kv_a [576, 6144]、kv_b [heads×448, 512]、o_proj [6144, heads×256]。L97-99 的注释解释了为什么要在这里查而不是等到 forward：错误形状的 checkpoint 会通过自洽的 upload 长度检查，然后死在很深的 GPU slice panic 里。生产路径 from_device 做同样的检查（[src/mla_front.rs:158-163](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L158-L163)），另外校验两个 layernorm gamma 的长度必须是 2048/512（[src/mla_front.rs:164-169](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L164-L169)）。

**头数推导**：[src/mla_front.rs:229-249](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L229-L249) 的 mla_heads 从（可能被 attention-TP 切片过的）q_b/kv_b/o_proj 形状反推本实例持有几个头：q_b 的行数必须是 256 的正倍数、不超过 64，且三个矩阵推出的头数必须一致。TP 分片时每 rank 持 8/64 个头，FlashMLA 的 query/latent 仍保持全宽（见 [L56-60](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L56-L60) 结构体注释）。

**config.json 探针**：识别期与启动期各跑一次的 probe_config_json 把这些维度钉进白名单校验——num_attention_heads = 64、q_lora_rank = 2048、kv_lora_rank = 512、qk_nope_head_dim = 192、qk_rope_head_dim = 64、v_head_dim = 256（[src/config.rs:102-110](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L102-L110)）。也就是说，Rust 侧常量与 HF config 是双向锁死的：任何一侧漂移都会在启动时被拒绝。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用一张真实 GLM5.2 的 config.json 验证 probe 的白名单行为，并手工核对一次形状推导。

1. 操作步骤（CPU 即可）：
   - 在 checkpoint 目录找到 config.json，读出 q_lora_rank、kv_lora_rank、qk_nope_head_dim、qk_rope_head_dim、v_head_dim、num_attention_heads 六个字段；

### 4.2 head 维度分解与 latent KV 表示

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

每个查询头的 256 维被拆成两部分：

- **nope 192 维**（GLM52_QK_NOPE_HEAD_DIM）：不做位置编码的「内容」部分，可以吸收进 latent 空间计算；
- **rope 64 维**（GLM52_QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM）：做 RoPE 旋转的部分。RoPE 的逐位置旋转无法塞进低秩 latent——旋转作用在原始 64 维坐标上，Q/K 必须在旋转后的空间里做内积，所以 rope 分量单独投影、单独缓存（k_pe）。

KV 侧同理：latent 512 维（kv_c，norm 之后）+ rope 64 维（k_pe）。**缓存里每 token 每层的 MLA 内容就是 512 + 64 = 576 个 bf16**，与头数无关——这就是 MLA 对 KV cache 的压缩本质。对比逐头 MHA：64 头 × 256 维 × 2（K 和 V）= 32768 个数，压缩比约 28 倍。

注意力打分的 softmax scale 也由这个分解决定：\( 1/\sqrt{256} = 0.0625 \)，即 GLM52_SM_SCALE（[src/config.rs:37-39](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L37-L39)），注释说明 rope_type 为 default 意味着没有 YaRN mscale 修正。

kv_b 的 448 = 192 + 256 行拆成两个吸收因子：

\[ W_{UK} = \text{kv\_b}[:, :192, :] \in \mathbb{R}^{64 \times 192 \times 512}, \quad W_{UV} = \text{kv\_b}[:, 192:, :] \in \mathbb{R}^{64 \times 256 \times 512} \]

u4-l3 会讲它们如何被「吸收」进 query 侧；本讲只需记住：**kv_b 不以 fp8 形式驻留，装载时在 host 上反量化成 bf16 的 W_UK/W_UV 上传**。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

kv 侧的数据流（decode 路径，fold_kv_pack = false）：

~~~text
hidden [T, 6144]
  --kv_a (fp8 GEMV/GEMM)-->  ckv [T, 576]        ← compressed_kv(512) 与 k_pe(64) 拼接存放
  --glm52_mla_ckv_split_launch-->  kv_c_raw [T, 512]  +  k_pe [T, 64]   ← 设备端拆包
  --rms_norm_rows_into(kv_a_ln, KV_LORA)-->  kv_c [T, 512]
~~~

要点：

- ckv 是「拼接布局」，因为 kv_a 是**一次** GEMM 算出 576 维；拆包（split）与 norm 是两个独立 kernel；
- norm 只作用于 512 维的 kv_c_raw，64 维 rope 分量**不做 norm**；
- FlashInfer 后端走 fold_kv_pack = true 时这条链在 front 里提前结束：split 与 norm 被融合进 attend 侧的 glm52_mla_front_pack_fp8_launch，ckv 保持 raw（[src/mla_front.rs:544-549](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L544-L549) 与 [src/mla_decode.rs:337](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_decode.rs#L337)）。同一条数学链，两种 kernel 编排——这是「算什么」与「怎么算」分离的典型例子。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**常量定义**：[src/config.rs:25-31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L25-L31)。注意 GLM52_QK_HEAD_DIM 和 GLM52_KV_A_OUT 都是**由两个分量相加推导**的 const 表达式，不是独立魔法数。

### 4.3 front scratch 持久缓冲与 fp8 投影调度

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

Glm52MlaFront 是前半场的全部中间量容器，设计上有三个关键决定：

1. **持久 + 原地覆写**：缓冲在启动期按 bucket 尺寸一次性分配，每步由 front_q/front_rest 原地写入。这是整步 CUDA Graph（u6-l3）的前提——graph 回放要求指针不变，原地覆写让「重放」等价于「重算」。
2. **78 层共享一个实例**：layer N 的 front 值在 layer N 的 attend 消费后即死，所以不需要 78 份 scratch（[src/mla_front.rs:300-307](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L300-L307) 的结构体注释）。
3. **行数烤进 scratch**：tokens 在构造时固定，所有 front kernel 从 front.tokens()（即 q_resid.tokens()）取行数，单一事实来源（[src/mla_front.rs:376-379](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L376-L379)）。

decode 与 prefill 两形态：decode 版多带 GEMV partial 缓冲、打包输出 sink 和（行数超过 8 时）wide GEMM scratch；prefill 版（new_prefill）把这些缩成 1 个元素的占位（[src/mla_front.rs:329-336](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L329-L336) 与 [L357-365](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L357-L365)），因为 prefill 永远走大 batch GEMM 路径。

**fp8 投影变体的行数适用域**（承接 u3-l1）：

| 变体 | 位置 | 适用域 | front 里的对应缓冲 |
|------|------|--------|--------------------|
| fp8_linear_into | [src/fp8.rs:392](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L392) | 小 m 的 weight-only GEMV（t 不超过 8） | gemv_partial |
| fp8_linear_pair_into | [src/fp8.rs:437](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L437) | t = 1，两个共享输入的投影并一次 grid | 复用输出缓冲 |
| fp8_linear_partials_into | [src/fp8.rs:415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L415) | mma 表有路由的打包权重（batched mma） | gemv_partial + qa_kva_out |
| fp8_linear_large_m_into | [src/fp8.rs:66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/fp8.rs#L66) | 大 m：激活量化 + groupwise GEMM（t 超过 8 或 prefill） | wide: Glm52Fp8GemmScratch |

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

decode 前半场被拆成两个入口（layer.rs 在中间插入 DSA 索引器）：

~~~text
layer 一步（简化）:
  glm52_mla_front_q_into(...)        # q 相：q_a 投影 + q_a_layernorm → q_resid
  —— 把 q_resid 交给 DSA 索引器（aux stream 可并行）——
  glm52_mla_front_rest_into(...)     # rest 相：q_b + kv_a + split + kv_a norm
~~~

front_q 内部按行数 t 分派 q_a（kv_a 同吃 hidden，被一并处理）：

~~~text
if t == 1:
    fp8_linear_pair_into(q_a, kv_a)          # 一次拼接 grid 算两个投影，少一个 graph 节点
elif qa_kva_fused(t):                        # mma 表对该行数与打包形状 [2624, 6144] 有路由
    fp8_linear_partials_into(qa_kva 打包权重)  # 部分和进 gemv_partial
    glm52_gemv_split_reduce_launch(...)       # 把部分和拆解回 q_a [T,2048] 与 ckv [T,576]
elif wide 存在 (t > 8):
    有打包权重: fp8_linear_large_m_into(qa_kva)   # 一次 GEMM + 一次激活量化
               + extract_hidden_rows_raw_into × 2  # 从 [T,2624] 切出 q_a 与 ckv
    无打包权重: fp8_linear_large_m_into(q_a)
else:
    fp8_linear_into(q_a)                      # 普通 weight-only GEMV（2..8 行且无路由）
最后统一: rms_norm_rows_into(q_a → q_resid)
~~~

front_rest 的 kv_a 有三个「跳过」条件（已经有人算过）：t == 1（pair 算过）、qa_kva_fused（fused mma 算过）、qa_kva_packed_wide（wide 打包 GEMM 算过），三者以或关系合并在一行判断里（[src/mla_front.rs:583](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L583)）。

- MLA 前半场 = 两条投影链：查询链 hidden [T,6144] → q_a [T,2048] → RMSNorm → q_resid → q_b → q_full [T,heads,256]，键值链 hidden → kv_a → ckv [T,576] → split → kv_c [T,512] + k_pe [T,64]；全部维度由 [src/config.rs:20-32](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L20-L32) 的编译期常量推导。
